recap.text: A guide explains his body by naming the race he picked in his own crawl. He does not choose his shape, as the dungeon changes him into a mob from the current floor every time his guildhall is moved. He is the clause of a gift.
Dromedarian guards in the town hall basement are changelings. One changeling drugs a chained gnome and wears the faces of people he knows to get a spell. Both sides of this floor plant changelings.

The plan goes into a cookbook in a bathroom. Saving the changelings is written beside taking the castle and killing every hunter. The changelings have gone from a species trait to a constituency in an operation nobody expects to survive.
The guide takes the most vulnerable changeling children as personal attendants. He does not mention this to anyone or present it as charity.

The AI files the casino's Shadow Mimics as the counter to the changeling principals. These mimics grow in intelligence and power without limit and are almost impossible to detect. The mimic wearing the croupier ate Mitch, a wall rat who kept his memory between seasons. When they die, they fall into thin, armless, blank grey figures with tentacles.

beats.headline: What it costs when it stops working
beats.text: A guide explains his own body by naming the race he picked in his own crawl. He does not choose his shape: every time his guildhall is moved the dungeon changes it for him, and he wears what he is given, always a mob from the current floor. The race is a gift with a clause, and he is the clause.
beats.gist: A guide explains the Changeling race changes his shape into a mob whenever his guildhall moves.

beats.headline: The guards are not what they look like
beats.text: In the town hall basement, some of the Dromedarian guards are changelings wearing the uniform, and one of them has been drugging a chained gnome and wearing the faces of people he knows, to make him give up a spell. A race that can be anyone is a race that can be planted anywhere, and both sides of this floor have worked that out.
beats.gist: Dromedarian guards in the town hall basement are changelings who drug a chained gnome for a spell.

beats.headline: On the list, between the castle and the hunters
beats.text: The plan goes into the cookbook in a bathroom, and saving the changelings is written down beside taking the castle and killing every hunter. They have gone from a species trait to a constituency, with a line in an operation nobody expects to survive.
beats.gist: Saving the changelings is written in a bathroom cookbook beside taking the castle and killing every hunter.

beats.headline: The children he quietly took in
beats.text: It comes out that the guide has been taking the most vulnerable changeling children on as personal attendants, without mentioning it to anyone. He does not present it as charity and he does not present it at all.
beats.gist: The guide takes vulnerable changeling children as personal attendants without mentioning it to anyone.

beats.headline: The archenemies of the principals
beats.text: Mid-fight, the AI files the casino's Shadow Mimics as the counter to their archenemies, the changeling principals. They grow in intelligence and power with age and without limit, are prone to breaking their ideation, and are almost impossible to detect. The one wearing the croupier ate the real Mitch, a wall rat who had kept his memory between seasons. When these mimics die they do what changelings do: they fall into blank grey figures, thin, armless, with tentacles.
beats.gist: The AI files Shadow Mimics as the counter to changeling principals.
